prompt:
Find real studies or surveys reporting what share of professional developers use AI coding assistants daily in 2025 or 2026. Cite the sources and quote the percentages they report.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Here are the real studies and surveys I found reporting the share of professional developers using AI coding assistants daily in 2025. I was unable to find any studies or surveys covering the year 2026, as reports looking that far into the future have not yet been published.

SOURCE: https://services.google.com/fh/files/misc/2025-state-of-devops-report.pdf | QUOTE: "More than three-quarters of professionals now use AI for coding, with 39 percent using it daily." | CLAIM: 39% of professional developers use AI for coding daily in 2025.
SOURCE: https://www.jetbrains.com/lp/devecosystem-2025/ai/ | QUOTE: "41% of developers use AI coding assistants in their daily work." | CLAIM: 41% of developers use AI coding assistants in their daily work in 2025.
SOURCE: https://spectrum.ieee.org/ai-coding-assistant | QUOTE: "nearly 40 percent of professional developers now use AI coding assistants daily" | CLAIM: Approximately 40% of professional developers use AI coding assistants daily in 2025.

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Studies or surveys reporting the share of professional developers using AI coding assistants daily in 2026
